name: breadcrumbs
description: The trail from the home page to the current one, each step a link, with a separator between them that is seen and not read.

children.description: The trail, in order, with role="list".
A step: a link, or plain text with aria-current="page" for the last.

tokens.name: --yeti-text-md
tokens.description: Text size when data-size is absent.

tokens.name: --yeti-space-sm
tokens.description: The space step when data-size is absent.

tokens.name: --yeti-space-xs
tokens.description: Gap between steps, and between a step and its separator.

tokens.name: --yeti-color-text
tokens.description: The current step, and a link under the pointer.

a11y.notes: Put aria-label="Breadcrumb" on the nav. The last step carries aria-current="page", as plain text or as a link to the page itself. The separators are CSS with empty alternative text, so assistive tech reads only the steps. Put role="list" on the ol.
